name: data.europa.eu (European Data Portal and EU Open Data Portal) search API
owner: Publications Office of the European Union
gives: catalogue of about 2.0 million dataset records from European public bodies, with licence and download links per dataset; high-value datasets flagged (is_hvd)

why.quote: The Publications Office of the European Union maintains this website to enhance public access to information about its initiatives and European Union policies in general.
why.basis: legal notice (a disclaimer; no reuse licence for the metadata found on that page); robots.txt allows the site's assets, full rules not read to the end

interface: GET https://data.europa.eu/api/hub/search/search?q=...&limit=n&filter=dataset returns JSON (count 2,029,216 records for the empty query; 53,168 for 'weather forecast'). Each record carries distributions (download URLs) and is_hvd. A SPARQL page exists at https://data.europa.eu/data/sparql (not used). No key.
notes: Keyless. The catalogue is metadata; each dataset has its own licence and publisher, which a collector must read per dataset. Metadata reuse licence not found on the legal notice (gap). The separate host api.data.europa.eu returned a proxy 502 and was not read. Rate limits not found. Useful for discovering Portugal and Europe-wide open datasets, not as data itself.
